memory_candidates.content: Instantiating omega_chain (FormalSystem/PlusLanguage/PlusOmegaChain.lean) carries an interval-endpoint discipline no docstring records: the segment property P's CONTENT window must sit strictly inside the (s, s'] agreement window that omega_chain's hP hypothesis offers. A guard sourced from an `untl` clause is therefore OPEN on the right -- at the right endpoint the until-witness carries the event (the eventuality formula), not the guard -- so a half-open P k eta s s' reading is not derivable from an until-shaped antecedent even though hP would accept it. The complementary marker-arithmetic fact: an until-form consequent needs the marker pair that STRADDLES an arbitrary s (c k <= s < c (k+1)), because the segment guard only exists between consecutive markers; an F-form's 'marker beyond s in a residue class' lemma (int_marker_exists_gt) cannot serve. Both facts generalize to any consumer splicing a one-step until-commitment into an infinite one.
